title: A base file with a syntax error (a missing ';' between two class fields) whose head adds the separator as a line break: the module goes from a SyntaxError at load to running

expectedChecks.reason: src/flags.ts: base has syntax errors; a layout change needs both sides to parse

notes: Round S8 (60b419d) required only head to parse; TypeScript's recovery for the missing ';' builds the tree that automatic semicolon insertion builds once a line break is there, so tokens and trees were equal and the static certificate was PASS with a layout-only finding.

origin.before: built by hand from the review's evidence
origin.after: a line break before dryRun, nothing else changed
